meta.name: apollo-observability
meta.description:
Set up Apollo.io monitoring and observability.
Use when implementing logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting
for Apollo integrations.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo monitoring", "apollo metrics",
"apollo observability", "apollo logging", "apollo alerts".

copy.tagline: 配置Apollo集成的日志、指标与告警
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在用Apollo集成并想看清它运行是否正常
copy.tagline_en: Set up logging, metrics, and alerts for Apollo integrations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Apollo integrations and need to monitor their health and performance

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 Apollo 集成搭建监控与可观测性:生成 Prometheus 指标、带 PII 脱敏的 JSON 日志、OpenTelemetry 分布式追踪、错误/限流/延迟告警规则、Grafana 仪表板和健康检查端点。
howto.when: 当你说出“apollo monitoring”“apollo metrics”等触发词,或要求为 Apollo 集成实现日志、指标、追踪等可观测性功能时触发。

say.text: 给 Apollo 集成配置监控和可观测性
say.note: 开始搭建指标、日志、追踪和告警。

say.text: 生成 Apollo 的 Prometheus 指标和 Grafana 仪表盘
为 Apollo 集成加上带 PII 脱敏的 JSON 日志

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude sets up monitoring and observability for Apollo integrations: Prometheus metrics, PII-redacted JSON logs, OpenTelemetry tracing, alert rules for errors/rate limits/latency, Grafana dashboards, and health check endpoints.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "apollo monitoring" or "apollo metrics", or when you ask to implement logging, metrics, or tracing for Apollo integrations.

say_en.text: Set up monitoring and observability for Apollo
say_en.note: Starts building metrics, logs, tracing, and alerts.

say_en.text: Generate Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards for Apollo
